## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI/CD

## Validation

- [ ] `flutter analyze`
- [ ] `flutter test`
- [ ] Manual test on target platform (if UI/behavior changed)

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept changes focused and limited in scope.
- [ ] I added/updated tests when behavior changed.
- [ ] I updated documentation (README/docs) if needed.
- [ ] I verified there are no breaking changes, or documented them clearly.

## Screenshots or logs (if applicable)

Add screenshots, recordings, or logs that help reviewers.
